title: Kidnapped Man Escapes Woman and Her 5 Lovers: Cops
description:
Bodycam footage shows Ohio police conducting a kidnapping investigation after a man asked a stranger at a gas station to send his mom a message. Maumee police then uncovered the truth — the victim was held by his alleged captors for about a week in a hotel room. The unnamed man identified his captors as a local woman and her five lovers. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
